scope: Saint Lucia medical discovery — International American University College of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: IAU describes a four-year MD programme with basic sciences in Saint Lucia completed in 20 months and clinical sciences at its Baltimore clinical campus; it states rotations are in teaching hospitals with ACGME-accredited residency programmes.

IAU's 2025–2026 admissions page lists basic-science tuition of US$7,500 per semester (semesters 1–4), US$7,100 for semester 5, and US$13,500 per clinical semester (semesters 6–10), together with academic prerequisites and English-test thresholds for applicants whose principal language is not English.
IAU publishes student financial-services, scholarship and financial-aid contact routes, but detailed eligibility and awards were not independently evaluated in this batch.
CAAM-HP's assessed-programme register lists International American University College of Medicine, Saint Lucia, as accreditation withdrawn, last updated November 2020.

holdReasons: IAU's current site claims government charter and accreditation, but CAAM-HP's assessed-programme register records accreditation withdrawn. Do not make unqualified accreditation, recognition, ECFMG or licensure claims.
A current direct Saint Lucia licensing/accreditation-board decision and current direct accreditor decision were not retrieved.
The university describes clinical training but named current hospital agreements, placement capacity, clinical eligibility and effective support-policy terms need direct validation.
nextAction: Keep held until Saint Lucia regulator and CAAM-HP status are reconciled in direct current records, with current clinical and support evidence.
